bull_case_summary: AppLovin combines 53% revenue growth with $863.3m quarterly FCF and only $461.766m net debt. Round two supports a purchase from 21.68x observed trailing earnings rather than relying entirely on 13.29x forecasts, accepting incomplete collection conversion.
bear_case_summary: The bear explicitly accepts defensible ownership and strong financing capacity. Its remaining objections are concentrated advertising economics, exceptionally high 77.68% operating margin and $2.171bn receivables, with the downtrend proving neither impairment nor a bottom.
key_points_of_agreement: Realised cash materially exceeds the net-debt balance without implying a repayment timetable.
Imperfect cash conversion remains compatible with strong absolute cash.
No verified misconduct or impairment is inferred from the selloff.
key_points_of_disagreement: How much durability and collection sensitivity constrain entry aggressiveness and expected return despite plausible valuation compensation.
unresolved_uncertainties: Persistence of platform economics and extraordinary margins.
Collections and actual price stabilisation, without assuming a bottom.
